details: The drag handler calls render() synchronously on every mousemove (line 406) while a continuous requestAnimationFrame animate loop also calls render() every frame, causing redundant double-renders during drag with no throttling or dirty-flag coalescing. No other interaction robustness issues found: the visualization is single-canvas with no cross-view dispatch, uses no D3 transitions (eliminating mid-flight race risk), and pointer events unify mouse/touch input cleanly.
